address: IOI Central Boulevard Towers, #07-02, 2 Central Boulevard, 018916, Singapore
bio: Tucked away in an office building, Sospiri prides itself on authentic Southern Italian cooking. Handmade pasta and seafood are served in portions generous enough for sharing. Fresh ingredients such as tomatoes, wild greens and baby artichokes are deftly crafted to bring out their natural flavours. Remember to save room for its traditional tiramisu. Wine buffs will appreciate the wine list that includes a wide selection of Italian labels....
